user.title: Quote of the Day
user.description: Choose where the daily quote comes from.

data_description.sources: Pick one or more sources; quotes from all of them are combined. The built-in collection is curated and works offline. ZenQuotes, BrainyQuote and FavQs are English online sources: their quotes are downloaded, filtered for quality and cached.
data_description.language: Which quotes to show. Online sources are English, so with 'Dutch' only the built-in collection is used.
data_description.cache_days: How long downloaded quotes are used before new ones are fetched. Only for online sources.
